description: This file defines the StorageHasherPicker class which implements the IStorageHasherPicker interface. It manages a collection of hash providers and provides a method to select a hash provider based on input parameters.

classes.name: StorageHasherPicker
classes.description: A class that implements IStorageHasherPicker, managing hash providers and selecting a hash provider.

methods.name: StorageHasherPicker
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the StorageHasherPicker with a collection of hash providers.

methods.name: PickHasher
methods.description: Method to select a hash provider from the collection, currently returning the first available provider.
